$comment: The ABI of the BN254 Solidity verifiers gnark exports (vk.ExportSolidity), per gnark version range [from, to). Read from the templates in the gnark module at v0.8.0, v0.9.0, v0.9.1, v0.10.0, v0.11.0, v0.12.0, v0.13.0, v0.14.0, v0.15.0, v0.16.0 and v0.16.4 (paths in `source`). N is the number of public inputs without commitment wires; K the number of commitments. `gnark-inventory verifier abi` compares a caller's interface with these.

templates.on_failure: returns false for a failed pairing; reverts for inputs >= r
reverts (ProofInvalid, PublicInputNotInField, CommitmentInvalid); no return value
templates.commitments: commitments and their proof of knowledge are separate arguments

templates.on_failure: reverts (ProofInvalid, PublicInputNotInField, CommitmentInvalid, "invalid proof length"); no return value
templates.commitments: packed in the proof bytes: 256 + 64*(K+1) bytes

templates.on_failure: returns false when the final pairing check fails; reverts on malformed input (the caller must check the bool)
templates.source: gnark/backend/plonk/bn254/solidity.go (v0.9.0 to v0.16.4; v0.9.0 is affected by GHSA-7p92-x423-vwj6)
